His hair is all white now; when he was young it was honey-gold like his daughter's. Pale green eyes. An ink callus on his right middle finger blacker than his daughter's. A mild, precise, gently stubborn air: asked how deep he went, he says the fifty-fifth floor, and adds that he counted three times. His white hair is short and neatly combed.

He holds a child's slate and a stick of chalk, a mild, patient look.

Pale gold curly hair. Lake-blue eyes. A small scar across the bridge of his nose from a fall off a terrace wall as a boy. A timid, earnest air: he does not quite dare to look at people when he speaks, and in the end he walked to the oath table by himself.

palette: slate green and wheat gold, lake blue, white, a little red ink

who: Cyprian Schoenberg, a human advocate of the upper city of the imperial capital, the expensive defender hired by all thirty-two accused houses together; forty-seven: tall and slender. A refined, cool, cutting air: he lost the great case and his fee doubled.

art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale violet eyes looking at the viewer through the gold monocle, a faint polite smile. Cold silver-white light from one side. name: 卢德维格·施瓦茨
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:5919
who: Ludwig Schwarz, a human, captain of the party called Day's End, which he named at sixteen and has led for thirty-six years; fifty-two: tall, with a slight stoop. Grizzled short hair. Pale blue eyes. Two fingers of his left hand were taken by the ice of the thirtieth floor. Few words, but his is the loudest voice in the party when he calls the retreat. A gruff, steady, trusting air: if the cook says eat, the whole party eats. His left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us) has only the thumb, index and middle finger: the ring and little fingers are gone, healed short stumps; his right hand is whole.
face: FACE, as in the references: a man's face of about fifty-two, weathered and steady, NOT young: narrow pale blue eyes with deep lines at their corners; grizzled brows; a straight nose; a firm mouth with short grizzled stubble. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool tone.
build: tall and rangy, with a slight stoop.
palette: deep grey and leather brown, pale blue, bronze, a little frost white
casual: His party captain's gear: a deep grey long travelling coat with leather-patched shoulders over a quilted jerkin, a scarf, dark trousers and heavy boots; the guild's bronze star-chart rank emblem, an astrolabe with linked stars, pinned at the chest; a coil of rope and a lantern at his belt; a long sword at his hip. He rests his maimed left hand on the sword hilt, a gruff, steady look.
private: Teaching at the survey bureau after he stepped down: a dark wool waistcoat over a white shirt, dark trousers and soft boots. He holds a sheet of drawing paper and runs the fingers of his good hand over it with his eyes closed. A calm, patient look.
battle: On the forty-fourth floor: the long coat belted over a boiled-leather jerkin, a rope tied from his belt back to his party, gauntlets. He grips the long sword in his right hand, the maimed left raised, the mouth open in a call, a hard, steady look.
formal: At the guild hall on the day all twelve came back: a clean dark coat buttoned to the collar, the star-chart emblem polished. He stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a gruff, moved look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale blue eyes looking at the viewer from under grizzled brows, the maimed left hand raised near his face holding a taut rope. Cold blue-black light from one side, like a darkness that swallows lamps. Foreground blur: a taut rope, drifting dust and a guttering lamp. He wears the deep grey travelling coat with the leather-patched shoulders.
art_extra: His hair stays grizzled grey as in the sprite, not blue; the cold light only rims its edge.

name: 安托万·贝特朗
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:5921
who: Antoine Bertrand, a human sorcerer trained at the adventurers' academy, the quick-tongued spellcaster of the party called Day's End; twenty-six: of middle height and slim. A mess of chestnut-red curly hair. Warm amber eyes behind round-framed spectacles, which he keeps on even in the darkness that swallows light, where they are of no use at all. A quick, cheeky, warm air: it was he who first called the party's cook by the name the whole guild came to use.
build: of middle height and slim.
palette: chestnut red and academy grey-green, warm amber, cream, a little fire orange
casual: His academy-trained gear: a grey-green short coat with the sleeves rolled up over a cream shirt, a long knitted scarf, dark trousers and sturdy boots; a satchel of chalk and spell papers at his side; the round spectacles on his nose. He holds a stick of chalk between two fingers, a quick, cheeky grin.
private: At the wine tent of the camp on the fortieth floor: a loose cream shirt with braces, dark trousers, the scarf loose, the spectacles pushed up into his curls. He holds a tin mug. A loose, laughing look.
battle: In the dark of the forty-fourth floor: the grey-green coat under a light leather jerkin, the scarf tied tight, the satchel at his side. He conjures a small ball of fire in his raised right hand and steadies his spectacles with the left, a determined, slightly reckless grin.
formal: On graduation day at the adventurers' academy: a dark grey-green academy coat buttoned to the collar with brass buttons, a white collar, the scarf in the academy colours, the curls refusing to stay combed. He holds a graduation cap in one hand, a proud, sheepish grin.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the amber eyes behind the round spectacles looking at the viewer, a small ball of fire flaring in his cupped hand. Warm orange firelight from one side against deep darkness. Foreground blur: sparks, drifting chalk dust and the end of a scarf. He wears the grey-green short coat with the long scarf.

name: 格丝·末钟
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:5923
who: Gess Lastbell, a demon-kin woman of the white-bone folk from the bell-tower tomb city, the appraiser the appraisal office sent down with the party Day's End; looking about thirty: slim and straight-backed. Skin white to the point of translucence, the shadows of bone showing faintly beneath it in the cold, and a small patch of bare bone at one temple. Long bone-white hair. Her eyes are dark, each holding a small point of cold blue light. A box of measuring instruments on her back. A measured, exact air: she speaks in the rhythm of reading out figures, and kept checking the cook's pulse after every pot.
face: FACE, as in the references: a woman's face of the white-bone folk, about thirty, calm and exact: almond eyes dark as hollows, each with a small point of cold blue light at its centre; thin pale brows; a small nose; a straight, unsmiling mouth; a small patch of bare white bone at one temple. Skin white to the point of translucence, with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool blue-grey. Her irises are near-black, dark as hollows, and at the centre of each burns one tiny point of cold blue light; the irises themselves are not blue. She wears no earrings.
build: slim and straight-backed.
palette: bone white and appraisal grey-white, cold blue, a little brass
casual: Her appraiser's dress: the long grey-white smock of the appraisal office, buttoned to the collar with the cuffs tied, over a dark dress, and sturdy boots; on her back a box of measuring instruments on straps; small brass scales at her belt. private: In the appraisal office at night, for her folk do not sleep: a long dark grey dress with a high collar, the smock off, the bone-white hair loose. She holds an open book of figures. A quiet, still look.
battle: On the forty-fourth floor: the grey-white smock belted over a padded jerkin, the instrument box strapped on her back. She holds a brass probe forward in one hand; she carries no weapon. A composed, measuring look.
battle_pose: 3) the field outfit: exact and composed, the feet a little apart, an unsmiling, measuring look, a brass probe held forward in one hand; she carries no weapon.
formal: At the appraisal office's yearly reading of its books: a long grey-white robe with a high collar, a small bronze appraiser's badge, the hair bound back. She stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a composed look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark eyes with their cold blue points of light looking at the viewer, a brass probe raised beside her face. Cold blue-white light from one side. Foreground blur: drifting bone dust, the edge of an instrument box and a hanging set of brass scales. She wears the grey-white appraiser's smock.
art_extra: Her eyes stay near-black with one tiny cold blue point of light at the centre of each, exactly as in the sprite; the irises are not blue.

name: 乔纳森·奥克利
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:5942
who: Jonathan Oakley, a human of the doorkeepers' family at the end of Hinge Lane, who at sixteen carried his family's old door down the shaft with his friend Drogan and named their party Behind a Hundred Doors; in his mid twenties: of middle height, lean and quick-handed. Pale apricot short hair. Honey-coloured eyes. A burn scar in the web of his left thumb from testing a lock with a red-hot wire at fourteen. He learned to pick locks crouching at the locksmith's door next to his own. A bright, daring, warm-hearted air. The burn scar sits in the web between the thumb and index finger of his left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us).
build: of middle height, lean and quick-handed.
palette: pale apricot and honey, doorkeeper's blue, worn leather brown, iron
casual: His party gear: a worn brown leather jacket over a cream shirt, a doorkeeper's deep blue scarf, dark trousers and sturdy boots; a roll of lock picks and a short pry bar at his belt; a stick of chalk in his pocket for marking doors; his one house key, its third tooth filed one stroke too deep, on a cord that he has slipped off his neck and spins around one finger; there is no other key on him and nothing hangs at his neck, its third tooth filed one stroke too deep. , a bright, daring grin.
private: At home at the end of Hinge Lane: a cream linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a knitted grey vest, dark trousers and soft shoes. He holds the house key up, about to open his own door. A warm, homecoming smile.
battle: In the long lane before the side hall of the forty-ninth floor: the leather jacket buttoned, leather bracers, the tool roll open at his belt. He holds a thin lock pick in one hand and the short pry bar in the other, ready to take a gate apart, a focused, fearless look.

formal: At the guild hall on the day he and Drogan signed their names: a clean deep blue doorkeepers' coat with the linked-rings mark at the cuffs, a white collar, polished boots. He stands very upright with the hands folded in front, a proud grin he cannot quite hide.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the honey eyes grinning at the viewer, the house key held up between two fingers near his face. Warm lamplight from a doorway on one side. Foreground blur: an iron door ring, three short chalk marks on a door frame and drifting dust. He wears the worn brown leather jacket with the blue scarf.

name: 琪娅·暖灰
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:5943
who: Kia Warmash, a tiefling White Candle healer of the party Behind a Hundred Doors, who chose the words warm ash for her name at sixteen, because the ash stays warm after the stove goes out; in her mid twenties: of middle height and slender. Two small horns at the temples. A long, thin tail. Thin pale-gold lines across her skin. Warm ash-brown hair cut to the shoulders. Ember-orange eyes. A gentle, steady, quietly brave air: she bound a friend's ruined hands round and round at a door with no frame. Her hair ends exactly at her shoulders, never longer.
build: of middle height and slender.
palette: warm ash brown and pale gold, healer's grey-white, ember orange, a little candle gold
casual: Her healer's gear: the grey-white robe of the White Candle with the hem cut to the knee, a short travelling cloak, dark leggings and sturdy boots; a medicine chest on her back; a lamp with a white candle hanging at her belt. private: At the party's lodgings: a long soft cream dress with long sleeves and a knitted shawl, the tail curled around one ankle. She holds a cup of warm tea in both hands. A soft, sleepy smile.
battle: At the door with no frame on the forty-ninth floor: the short robe belted over a padded jerkin, the medicine chest on her back. battle_pose: 3) the descent outfit: steady and ready, the feet a little apart, a calm, brave look, a white-candle lamp held up in one hand and a roll of bandage in the other; she carries no weapon.
formal: At the White Candle chapel in Arcadia: a long white vestment with a silver candle embroidered at the chest, a white stole, the hair neatly tied back. art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the ember-orange eyes warm and steady, the pale-gold lines on her cheek and neck catching warm candlelight from one side. Foreground blur: a white bandage unrolling, a candle flame and drifting ash. She wears the knee-length White Candle robe.

name: 老克莱

who: Old Klee, a human locksmith of Hinge Lane in the bell-tower district, who has mended locks for forty years, father of the lock-breaker Novian; in his early sixties: of middle height and lean. A quiet, plain air: the first thing he taught his son was that locks do not lie, only the people who open them.

name: 穆丽尔·晨炉
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:5992
who: Muriel Dawnoven, a human baker of Laundry-Line Lane, from three generations who bake the first batch before dawn; seventy-four: short and round. White hair wrapped in a blue cloth. A layer of flour on both forearms. Pale blue eyes that close to two slits when she laughs. A quick, busy, warm air: she talks while she kneads, tells everyone to sit down, and never told the girl she fed for years where her own home was.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old woman's face of about seventy-four, round and kind, NOT young: pale blue eyes closing to two slits in a laughing smile, deep laugh lines; thin white brows; a round nose; a warm, chattering mouth. Clean skin with very little shading and soft wrinkles; skin shadows a soft warm pink-orange.
build: short and round, with strong forearms from kneading.
palette: flour white and bread brown, pale blue, a little hearth orange

private: Resting by her oven: a grey knitted shawl over the brown dress, the apron still on, slippers. She holds a hard heel of bread wrapped in a cloth, as if to slip it into someone's hand. A soft, fond look.

name: 汉弗莱·克罗夫特
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:6008
who: Humphrey Croft, a human of a cadet branch of the Silversail shipowners, the oldest captain of the navy, master of the great escort ship, who taught a fourteen-year-old ship's boy to touch the planks before boarding; sixty-nine: of middle height, square and sturdy. A terse air: one sentence, one order; he calls people boy when he scolds them and calls them by their ship's name when he praises them. His right hand (on the viewer's left when he faces us) has only the thumb, index and middle finger: the ring and little fingers are gone, healed short stumps; his left hand is whole.

who: Eugen Salzmann, a human, head of the greatest salt house of the southern borderland and leader of the nine merchant houses that blocked the roads; sixty-two: short and fat. Silver-white curly hair cropped very short. Water-blue eyes that look at your hands for rings before they look at your face. On his right thumb a gold ring cut with a salt jar, which he does not take off even to press a seal. A smooth, polite, round-spoken air: the more courteous he becomes, the more careful you should be.

Pale gold long hair in one braid down her back. Deep blue eyes. A pair of small copper studs shaped like bridges in her earlobes, the Zellner family mark. build: tall and thin, with long legs.
palette: slate grey and black, pale gold, deep blue, copper

art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the deep blue eyes looking straight at the viewer, a copper bridge stud glinting in her ear. Cool morning light from one side.
